benchmark.timing_convention: Piped decode/encode overlap inference; wait durations are not codec compute time. Forward timing synchronizes CUDA; ORT session.run includes copies.

observations.scope: Preliminary static review: five normalized frames, selected matching frame62 crops and selected seam crops; continuous normal-speed motion not viewed
observations.detail: No obvious useful microdetail increase; frame62 matching normalized SPAN eye/lash and hair crops appear smoother and less finely separated than Vimeo.
observations.temporal: NOT_ASSESSED: shimmer/flicker/crawling require human normal-speed/slow review. Adjacent-frame MAD is diagnostic, not a quality score.
observations.tile_seams: No conspicuous hard seam in inspected frame62 vertical/horizontal blend crops; overlays show geometry only, not seam detection.
observations.identity: No conspicuous large eye/nose/lip/jaw/hairline change on the five-frame sheet; not a complete identity or temporal stability assessment.
observations.artifacts: Smoothing dominates inspected SPAN crops; no conspicuous halo, invented pore pattern or newly recovered individual lashes in those crops.
observations.practical: Native4x is larger but does not establish useful detail; processing and RSS cost exceed prior Vimeo. Suitability/winner remains with human.
